avatar.description: One of the 5 predefined avatars; null until chosen.

avatarRequired.description: True while no avatar is chosen. Chat endpoints/socket answer AVATAR_REQUIRED until then.

content.description: Plain text (trimmed, control chars stripped). Service enforces CHAT_GENERAL_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH.

clientMessageId.description: Client-generated idempotency key (unique per author). Echoed back so the optimistic bubble can be swapped in place.

lastReadSeq.description: `seq` of the newest message visible on screen.
